<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_VacationRequest" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacations Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_VacationRequest">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_RequestSubmitted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Activity_SubmitRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Activity_ReviewRejectionReasons</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RequestRejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ImmediateSupervisor" name="Immediate Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Activity_ReviewRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ApprovalDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Activity_GenerateHRNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HRRepresentative" name="Human Resources Representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Activity_CompleteHRProcedures</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RequestApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" name="Vacation request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubmitToReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Activity_SubmitRequest" name="Submit vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToSubmit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubmitToReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Activity_ReviewRequest" name="Review vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubmitToReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" name="Request approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Activity_ReviewRejectionReasons" name="Review rejection reasons">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RejectedToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestRejected" name="Request rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RejectedToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Activity_GenerateHRNotification" name="Generate notification to HR representative">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotificationToHR</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Activity_CompleteHRProcedures" name="Complete vacation management procedures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotificationToHR</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HRToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestApproved" name="Vacation request approved and processed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HRToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToSubmit" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Activity_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitToReview" sourceRef="Activity_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Activity_ReviewRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToDecision" sourceRef="Activity_ReviewRequest" targetRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" targetRef="Activity_ReviewRejectionReasons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RejectedToEnd" sourceRef="Activity_ReviewRejectionReasons" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" targetRef="Activity_GenerateHRNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotificationToHR" sourceRef="Activity_GenerateHRNotification" targetRef="Activity_CompleteHRProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HRToEnd" sourceRef="Activity_CompleteHRProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestApproved"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacations Request" isExecutable="false">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RequestRejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ImmediateSupervisor" name="Immediate Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveVacationRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ApprovalDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_VacationRequestSubmission" name="Vacation request submission started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToSubmit</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitVacationRequest" name="Submit vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToSubmit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubmitToRegister</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RegisterToReceive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReceiveVacationRequest" name="Receive vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RegisterToReceive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveToDecide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest" name="Approve or reject vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveToDecide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DecideToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DecideToGateway</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewToRejectedEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewToRejectedEnd</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotificationToReceiveHR</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveHRToComplete</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CompleteToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToRejectedEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" targetRef="Task_GenerateHRNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotificationToReceiveHR" sourceRef="Task_GenerateHRNotification" targetRef="Task_ReceiveHRNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveHRToComplete" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveHRNotification" targetRef="Task_CompleteVacationManagementProcedures"/>
